review: 306.5d-1: second_activation said Ajani had activated -1 earlier, inconsistent with the 4 loyalty counters in the setup; delta now states an earlier activation already reflected in the shown counters.
306.2-1: base decision was ambiguous about B's response; base now has B pass, and the countered delta states B casts Counterspell instead.

scenarios.title: A planeswalker can be cast only in a main phase of its owner's turn with an empty stack

setup.notes: A has priority. In the stack_not_empty variant the stack holds {'card': 'Shock', 'controller': 'B', 'targets': ['A']}; Shock is not in any other zone.

decisions: A attempts to cast Jace Beleren, tapping three Islands.

variants.label: main_empty_stack
variants.expected: Casting Jace Beleren is legal (can_play true); it goes on the stack as a spell.

variants.label: combat_phase
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: Casting Jace Beleren is illegal (can_play false): it is not a main phase and Jace has no flash. Jace stays in A's hand.

variants.label: stack_not_empty
variants.delta: A Shock spell controlled by B targeting A is on the stack.
variants.expected: Casting Jace Beleren is illegal (can_play false): the stack is not empty. Jace stays in A's hand.

variants.label: opponents_turn
variants.delta: B is the active player in main1 with an empty stack.
variants.expected: Casting Jace Beleren is illegal (can_play false): it is not A's turn. Jace stays in A's hand.

scenarios.title: A resolving planeswalker spell enters the battlefield under its controller's control
decisions: A casts Jace Beleren, tapping three Islands.
B passes priority and A passes; Jace Beleren resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Jace Beleren resolves and enters the battlefield under A's control.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B, with priority after A casts Jace Beleren, casts Counterspell targeting it, tapping both Islands; both players pass.
variants.expected: Counterspell resolves; Jace Beleren is countered and moves to A's graveyard without entering the battlefield; Counterspell moves to B's graveyard.

scenarios.title: Two planeswalkers with the same name are subject to the legend rule
decisions: A casts the second Jace Beleren from hand, tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; Jace Beleren resolves and enters with 3 loyalty counters.
A, as the legend rule requires, chooses to keep the new Jace Beleren.

variants.label: same_name
variants.expected: The older Jace Beleren moves to A's graveyard in the state-based check; the new Jace Beleren stays with 3 loyalty counters.

variants.label: different_name
variants.delta: The card in A's hand is Jace, the Mind Sculptor (2UU, loyalty 3) instead, cast tapping all four Islands.
variants.expected: Both planeswalkers stay on the battlefield, each with 3 loyalty counters; nothing goes to the graveyard.

scenarios.title: A planeswalker enters with loyalty counters equal to its printed loyalty
decisions: A casts Jace Beleren, tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; Jace Beleren resolves.

variants.label: printed_loyalty
variants.expected: Jace Beleren enters with 3 loyalty counters (its printed loyalty).

variants.label: doubling_season
variants.delta: A also controls Doubling Season on the battlefield (its mana is not needed).
variants.expected: Jace Beleren enters with 6 loyalty counters: the entering replacement puts 3 counters and Doubling Season doubles that.

scenarios.title: The loyalty of a planeswalker on the battlefield equals its loyalty counters

setup.notes: Ajani Goldmane (printed loyalty 4) has not activated a loyalty ability this turn. Loyalty is counted in loyalty counters.

decisions: A activates Ajani Goldmane's +1 (you gain 2 life), adding a loyalty counter as the cost.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: plus_one
variants.expected: Ajani has 5 loyalty counters, so its loyalty is 5; A gains 2 life (22).

variants.label: minus_one
variants.delta: A activates the -1 ability instead (put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control; A controls none).
variants.expected: Ajani has 3 loyalty counters, so its loyalty is 3; nothing else changes.

variants.label: ultimate
variants.delta: A attempts to activate the -6 ability instead.
variants.expected: Activation is illegal (can_play false): Ajani has only 4 loyalty, fewer than 6 counters to remove; its loyalty stays 4.

scenarios.forge_notes: The ultimate variant is a playability verdict whose input is the loyalty value.

scenarios.title: A loyalty ability can be activated only at sorcery timing, once per permanent per turn

setup.notes: Ajani Goldmane has not activated a loyalty ability this turn. In the stack_not_empty variant the stack holds {'card': 'Shock', 'controller': 'B', 'targets': ['A']}.

decisions: A, with priority, activates Ajani Goldmane's +1 (you gain 2 life).
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: sorcery_timing
variants.expected: Activation is legal (can_play true); Ajani has 5 loyalty counters and A gains 2 life.

variants.label: second_activation
variants.delta: Ajani Goldmane already activated a loyalty ability earlier this turn (its +1, which resolved; the 4 loyalty counters shown already reflect it).
variants.expected: Activating +1 is illegal (can_play false): Ajani already activated a loyalty ability this turn.

variants.label: combat_phase
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: Activation is illegal (can_play false): it is not a main phase.

variants.label: stack_not_empty
variants.delta: A Shock spell controlled by B targeting A is on the stack.
variants.expected: Activation is illegal (can_play false): the stack is not empty.

scenarios.title: Planeswalkers can be attacked
decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker against Jace Beleren.

variants.label: opposing_planeswalker
variants.expected: The attack is legal: Jace Beleren (B's planeswalker) is a legal attack target for Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: own_planeswalker
variants.delta: A declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker against Ajani Goldmane, A's own planeswalker.
variants.expected: The attack is illegal: a player cannot attack a planeswalker they control.

scenarios.title: Damage dealt to a planeswalker removes that many loyalty counters
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Jace Beleren, tapping Mountain.
B passes; both players pass and Shock resolves.

variants.label: damage_dealt
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to Jace Beleren; 2 loyalty counters are removed and it has 1 loyalty counter. Shock moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: damage_prevented
variants.delta: In response, B casts Healing Salve choosing the prevention mode targeting Jace Beleren, tapping Plains.
variants.expected: Healing Salve resolves first and Shock's 2 damage is prevented: no loyalty counters are removed and Jace Beleren keeps 3 loyalty counters.

scenarios.title: A planeswalker with 0 loyalty is put into its owner's graveyard
decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Jace Beleren, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: zero_loyalty
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage, removing all 3 loyalty counters; Jace Beleren has 0 loyalty and moves to B's graveyard in the next state-based check.

variants.label: one_loyalty_left
variants.delta: A casts Shock (2 damage) instead of Lightning Bolt.
variants.expected: Shock removes 2 loyalty counters; Jace Beleren has 1 loyalty and stays on the battlefield.
